required_checks: Verify both restored source rows are the same valid Concept question and the candidate answers compilation/execution differences rather than drifting into a generic language comparison.
Verify typical C++ is scoped to an AOT toolchain and describes preprocess/compile/assemble/link without claiming all C++ execution must always follow one pipeline.
Verify javac class-file compilation is separated from JVM runtime execution and that interpretation/JIT are implementation execution strategies rather than mutually exclusive language labels.
Verify CPython source compilation to code objects/bytecode and pyc caching are distinguished from native-machine-code AOT compilation.
Verify CPython bytecode is not presented as a stable cross-implementation language ISA.
Verify portability claims distinguish source portability, standardized VM artifacts and platform-bound native binaries.
Verify performance claims remain conditional on optimizer, runtime profiling, GC/memory model, dynamic checks, native libraries and workload.
Verify at least three topic-specific follow-ups are directly answered and no absolute language-speed ranking is asserted.
